arcana-proxy._comment: Licensed Arcana Proxy (AI Gateway API). proxy-arcana.otnelhq.com is canonical; workers.dev is the fallback origin.
arcana-proxy.name: Arcana Proxy

cloudflare-ai-gateway._comment: Direct Cloudflare AI Gateway — requires CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID + CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY. Prefer arcana-proxy for licensed Arcana routing.
cloudflare-ai-gateway.name: Cloudflare AI Gateway

cloudflare-workers-ai._comment: Direct Workers AI — requires CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID + CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY. Licensed users should use arcana-proxy (auto when ~/.arcana/proxy_key exists).
cloudflare-workers-ai.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
